# SendUDPMsg

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Network](BlitzBasic-Network)

</div>


```blitzbasic
SendUDPMsg:Void udp_stream:Int32, dest_ip:Int32, dest_port:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `udp_stream` | In | Int32 | required | The stream to send from. |
| `dest_ip` | In | Int32 | required | The receiver's address as a number. |
| `dest_port` | In | Int32 | `0` | The receiver's port. Defaults to 0, which means the port of this stream. |

## Description

Sends what you wrote to the stream as one message and empties the stream for the next one.

## Differences

* Only IPv4 addresses fit in a number, use [SendUDPMsgTo](SendUDPMsgTo) for IPv6.
